text: delete_all_existing focuses the control, synthesizes accelerator+A, focuses again and synthesizes KEY_Delete. It exercises keyboard events instead of assigning element.value="". The deleted delete_existing helper simulated a requested number of Backspace presses, which is a different contract. Recommend preserving the remaining helper's all-text intent and event route when reusing it. These observations are scoped to the cited accepted source and historical changes. Full Bugzilla and historical review timeline/inline discussion remain pending. No Thunderbird runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check was run.
title: Preserve event-driven keyboard input in the remaining deletion helper
